title: Ibzan of Bethlehem Judges Israel (7 years)
summary: Ibzan of Bethlehem, who had thirty sons and thirty daughters, judges Israel seven years (Judg 12:8–10).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1146 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
chronologies.note: Jones, 15th ed. (2002), ch. V p. 85: "1146 – 7 – 10 – 8 = 1121 BC" (Ibzan, Elon, Abdon).

chronologies.date: 2823d AM, 1181 BC (Jephthah dies; Ibzan judges 7 years)
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §373 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

chronologies.date: "2884 - Beginning of Ibzan's 7-year judgeship in the Center and North (Jud. 11:9)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. Reference "Jud. 11:9" as printed (Ibzan is Judg 12:8-10).

chronologies.date: "2859 - Death of Jephthah, beginning of Ibzan's 7-year judgeship in the Center and North (Jud. 11:9)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory).

chronologies.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 8, chart "Year of the World: From the Judges to King Saul (Chronology from James Jordan)"
chronologies.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2884.
